meta.description: Minimal RPC over HTTP for kvpack messages: a Go server that dispatches each request to the handler of its command, and clients that post a request and read the reply. One POST per call, body application/x-kvpack, errors as kvpack error replies on status 200. Typed handlers and calls on the structs the kvpack generator writes from a .kvp declaration. Use when a Go server exposes commands to Go, C or Harbour clients and gRPC is too much. Triggers on microrpc, application/x-kvpack over HTTP, or "RPC between Go and C/Harbour" tasks.
